ctx.title: Ramayana Overseas Box Office: Ranbir Kapoor Dethrones Salman Khan After 4141 Days From The Top 3, Next Target – 2 Aamir Khans!
ctx.summary:
Ramayana has entered the top 3 highest grossing Bollywood films of all time overseas box office and now moves towards the next spot! 
 The post  Ramayana Overseas Box Office: Ranbir Kapoor Dethrones Salman Khan After 4141 Days From The Top 3, Next Target – 2 Aamir Khans!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Ramayana Box Office is celebrating big time since a legendary international box office fortress has officially fallen! Completing 12 days at the global ticket window, director Nitesh Tiwari’s mythological visual spectacle has charged to a phenomenal 495.15 crore gross across international markets, officially dethroning Salman Khan’s Bajrangi Bhaijaan!
Officially, Ramayana is now the third highest-grossing Bollywood film of all time overseas, with a gross collection of 495.15 crore. It has pushed Bajrangi Bhaijaan to number 4 on the list. Salman Khan’s film earned a total gross collection of 482.54 crore at the box office overseas!
Bajrangi Bhaijaan ruled at the box office for almost 4000 days, as the film secured a spot in the top 3 overseas grossers! However, Salman Khan’s biggie will now be out of the top 3, as Ranbir Kapoor’s Film takes the third spot.
Interestingly, Ramayana is inching towards the 500 crore mark at the overseas box office and is less than 5 crore away from hitting the mark! Released back on July 17, 2015, Kabir Khan and Salman Khan’s heartwarming emotional drama has ruled in the top 3 spots for more than 11 years!
Ramayana’s next two targets now are two Aamir Khan films – Secret Superstar and Dangal- on the international leaderboard! While Bajrangi Bhaijaan built its 482.54 crore international tally through a robust Phase 1, coupled with a massive 2018 China expansion, Ramayana has eclipsed that 11-year record in just 12 days of Phase 1 release alone, without a single ticket sold yet in China, Japan, or South Korea!
With the 500 crore overseas club ready to be unlocked today and only Aamir Khan’s two global record-holders standing ahead, Ranbir Kapoor and Yash continue to redefine international box office boundaries!
